definition.population: Adult ICU stays; first observed creatinine-defined AKI; prior AKI/dialysis/RRT excluded
definition.onset: first qualifying creatinine SAMPLE measurement time, using final available corrections; not biological onset
definition.features: Only measurements and revisions available by prediction time
definition.baseline: minimum earlier measured creatinine within 7 days of the qualifying sample
definition.minimum_inputs: Recent creatinine, valid earlier 7-day comparison, >=3 measurement groups in preceding 24h
definition.negative_label: full 24h ICU follow-up and a creatinine sample collected in hours 18-24 of horizon
definition.rrt: Censor if RRT begins before a future observed AKI endpoint; exclude already collected AKI samples even if not yet reported
limitations: Unknown pre-admission AKI/CKD can be misclassified
Intermittent testing can miss true physiologic onset
Urine intervals not inferred from irregular source charting; primary outcome is creatinine-defined
Discharge, death or missing late creatinine causes censoring; informative observation remains possible
No prospective or clinical validation; selected source demos are not representative
definition.documentation_time: First recognition preserves earliest as-of qualifying versions; current stage/value still reflect latest corrected results.
